title: Sally Ride became the first American woman in space
summary: When she was launched with four other astronauts aboard the space shuttle Challenger, Sally Ride became the first American woman to fly into outer space. Following Ride's death in 2012, obituaries revealed her long-term relationship with another woman, Tam O'Shaughnessy. Ride kept her sexual orientation private during her NASA career, but the reveal meant that, in 1983, she was also the first known LGBTQ astronaut to fly.
